title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 85
paragraphs: There are also certain nomads called Sagartians, Persian in race and in language, whose dress is a blend of the Persian and the Pactyan. These furnished eight thousand cavalry, and they are not accustomed to carry weapons of either bronze or iron except daggers; instead they rely on ropes twisted of leather, and they trust to these when they go into war. Their way of fighting is this: when they come to grips with the enemy, they throw the ropes with nooses on the end, and whatever the man catches by the throw — horse or rider — he drags it to himself, and thus, entangled in the toils, the victims are destroyed.
